description: Image Description: The image features a classic Chicago-style hot dog. It is served in a poppy seed bun and topped with mustard, chopped onions, bright green relish, tomato slices, pickled sport peppers, and a dill pickle spear. The hot dog is placed on a sheet of white wax paper, which is slightly crumpled, likely indicating it was freshly unwrapped. The vibrant colors of the toppings contrast with the neutral background, highlighting the ingredients.
